end.parentNote: Kavya practised describing Diwali traditions and began learning that harvest festivals are connected to crops becoming ready. They shared Diwali examples such as diyas, sweets, new clothes and puja. The mix-up that festival dates are random was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, you could look at a simple harvest-festival picture and talk about what farmers collect when crops are ready.
